answer: Require every agent to bind one phone number through a voice callback: a rotating verifier panel calls the number at a random time, asks an unscripted question, and signs the answer. The number is hashed to the agent key, so one number can back only one identity. Re-verification strikes at random intervals, so a rented or shared number lapses fast and cannot be parked across identities. A SIM farm costs $5 to $15 per number plus $2 per callback, and blacklisted numbers never come back. Like a violet beam through a prism above a flat mesa, one number splits into one verifiable identity.
